title: Persistent eventual diagonal equation for one overlap test
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R a diagram of Noetherian commutative rings, c an affine limit cone of Spec(R), and f:X_i→Spec(R_i) a quasi-compact quasi-separated locally finitely presented morphism [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions, def-pc-base-change]. Fix j≥i, a finite affine open cover U of X_j, and finitely presented quasi-coherent modules N_a on its charts [pqf-def-coherent]. Suppose k≥j and natural overlap transitions T on U pulled back to X_k [def-pc-local-overlap-transitions] have components isomorphic to the pullbacks of N_a, and the limit pullback of T is coherent. Fix one chart a. There is l≥k such that at every m≥l the prescribed canonical refinement pullback of T has identity self transition on the diagonal test of chart a.

source.place: Tag 01ZR, first proof (Zariski gluing), and clause (3); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01ZR

proof.text: Use the component isomorphism to transfer finite presentation from the pullback of N_a to T.obj a, using the proved upstream isFinitePresentation_pullback and isFinitePresentation_of_iso. Its identity pullback M is finitely presented, hence quasi-coherent and of finite type. Let d be the diagonal transition on M and δ=d−id.

The proved private lemma diagonal_pull_iff uses pulledHom_eq and pullHom_hom to express the pulled diagonal transition as an isomorphism conjugate of the chart pullback of d. Conjugation fixes and reflects identities. Apply this equivalence to the limit chart and use the hom_self field of limit coherence. Additivity shows that the limit pullback of δ is zero.
Apply finitePresentation_chart_map_zero_eventually to M,M,δ and the limit-zero equation. It gives l≥k and zero pullback along the canonical refinement map from l to k.

For any m≥l, prove the canonical refinement chart map from m to k is the composite of those from m to l and l to k: apply pullback.hom_ext and the two overlapRefinementHom projection equations, then overlapStageMap_comp. Naturality of pullbackComp and preservation of zero imply the direct pullback of δ to m is zero. Additivity gives pullback(d)=id; diagonal_pull_iff now proves exactly the prescribed pulled transition diagonal equation.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01ZR (3): identity defect, one-stage chart map vanishing, and explicitly proved persistence and transition conjugation

theorem finitePresentation_overlap_diagonal_eventually
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (U : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).OpenCover.{u})
    [Finite U.I₀] [∀ a, IsAffine (U.X a)]
    (N : (a : U.I₀) → (U.X a).Modules)
    (a : U.I₀)
    (hN : ∀ a, (N a).IsFinitePresentation) (hNq : ∀ a, (N a).IsQuasicoherent)
    :
    ∀ (k : I) (hjk : j ≤ k),
      let q₀ := overlapStageMap R f hij hjk
      let V₀ : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk))))).OpenCover.{u} :=
        U.pullback₁ q₀
      let p₀ := overlapLimitMap R c f (hij.trans hjk)
      ∀ T : modulesPseudofunctor.OverlapTransitions V₀.f,
        (∀ a, Nonempty ((T.obj a : (V₀.X a).Modules) ≅
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q₀ a)).obj (N a))) →
        (T.pull (p := p₀) (α := fun a ↦ a)
          (fun a ↦ V₀.pullbackHom_map p₀ a)).Coherent →
        ∃ (l : I) (hkl : k ≤ l), ∀ (m : I) (hkm : k ≤ m), l ≤ m →
          let q := overlapStageMap R f hij (hjk.trans hkm)
          let V : (pullback f (Spec.map
              (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans (hjk.trans hkm)))))).OpenCover.{u} :=
            U.pullback₁ q
          let r := overlapStageMap R f (hij.trans hjk) hkm
          let s := overlapRefinementHom U q₀ q r
            (overlapStageMap_comp R f hij hjk hkm)
          let T' := T.pull (p := r) (α := fun a ↦ a) (p' := s)
            (fun a ↦ overlapRefinementHom_map U q₀ q r
              (overlapStageMap_comp R f hij hjk hkm) a)
          T'.hom (V.f a) (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (Category.id_comp _) (Category.id_comp _) = 𝟙 _
